data.gender_notes: Huwainaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'hawwana' which means 'to be gentle, delicate, and radiant'. In Islamic culture, the name Huwainaa symbolizes the gentle, graceful, and radiant nature of a newborn girl. It is a beautiful name that is often given to girls who are believed to possess these qualities. The name Huwainaa carries the meaning “Graceful, Delicate, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Huwainaa usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, delicate, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
